notes:
Inbound SMB from mid-sized niche retailer. Use-case: product Q&A inside PDP and site chat, plus nightly catalog enrichment (auto-categories, title normalization). Customer profile: small engineering team (2 backend, 1 frontend, 1 data), price sensitive but willing to pay for reliability during promotional spikes. Quote from CTO: 'We need answers on product pages to be snappy — customers bounce if chat is slow.'

Trial details / POC scope:
- 1-week Hosted API trial against a 3k SKU subset (images + descriptions). Evaluate: embeddings recall for search, chat relevance for Q&A, token cost per 1k queries.
- Latency targets: p50 < 250ms for short Q&A queries; p95 < 1s acceptable during bulk reindex.
- Throughput/traffic pattern: baseline 2-5 qps, weekend spikes up to 80-120 qps for 2-4 hours.
- Cost sensitivity: target monthly spend <$500 in pilot; willing to move to $1-2k/mo if metrics hold.
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated smaller open models (quantized) to control cost; asked about automatic fallback to higher-cap models if quality drops.

Technical / security notes:
- Deployment: public cloud only; will not pursue VPC right now.
- Wants audit log export and 30-day retention for review. No SSO requirement yet.
- Data: PII minimal (product text, some vendor notes). Will not upload customer emails.

Sales cadence & next actions:
- Ethan to provision API keys scoped to experiment + sample prompt set by 2026-03-12.
- SE to share caching & batching guide and suggested model/quantization profile.
- Schedule a short sync after 3 days of trial to review token cost and relevance (tentative 2026-03-16).

Blockers: legal asks for simple retention statement; finance needs monthly estimate for promotional spike. Customer asked for example bills for similar customers.

CRM shorthand: "good fit for hosted -> low lift. Needs proof of latency & cost controls. Push caching + model suggestion. Ask: sample billing for 100 qps 2hr burst."
